segment.source: Death lives here. Welcome to the morgue, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>
segment.target: Death lives here. Welcome to the morgue, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>

segment.source: But I have not chosen death...<end>
segment.target: But I have not chosen death...<end>

segment.source: No... you chose to ignore him.<end>
segment.target: No... you chose to ignore him.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Who is he?<end>
segment.target: Who is he?<end>

segment.source:
Dr. Mason. Everyone died; no one lived. Yet he is unable to settle.
It's his mind, you see: It is exceptional.<end>
segment.target:
Dr. Mason. Everyone died; no one lived. Yet he is unable to settle.
It's his mind, you see: It is exceptional.<end>

segment.source: He can reach other minds, minds like yours. You are the first to approach him in a long, long time, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>
segment.target: He can reach other minds, minds like yours. You are the first to approach him in a long, long time, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>

segment.source: Who are you?<end>
segment.target: Who are you?<end>

segment.source: I am but a vessel, a Servant - not his, but yours. I am the link.<end>
segment.target: I am but a vessel, a Servant - not his, but yours. I am the link.<end>

segment.source: Even though you ignored him, a link between you two has been established.<end>
segment.target: Even though you ignored him, a link between you two has been established.<end>

segment.source: You understand him. A strong link between you two has been established.<end>
segment.target: You understand him. A strong link between you two has been established.<end>

segment.source: A link between you two has been established despite you inconsistent behavior.<end>
segment.target: A link between you two has been established despite you inconsistent behavior.<end>

segment.source: Why did I get those visions?<end>
segment.target: Why did I get those visions?<end>

segment.source: Communication. He can only reach you through your mind, and only through emotions.<end>
segment.target: Communication. He can only reach you through your mind, and only through emotions.<end>

segment.source: Why me?<end>
segment.target: Why me?<end>

segment.source: There is no one else, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>
segment.target: There is no one else, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>

segment.source: What about the other Servants?<end>
segment.target: What about the other Servants?<end>

segment.source: They are just like me. I am simply the one closest to him.<end>
segment.target: They are just like me. I am simply the one closest to him.<end>

segment.source: What now?<end>
segment.target: What now?<end>

segment.target: Resolution... $(#sir/ma'am).<end>

segment.source: I am ready.<end>
segment.target: I am ready.<end>

segment.source: He desires... yearns for resolution. He chose death a long time ago. <end>
segment.target: He desires... yearns for resolution. He chose death a long time ago. <end>

segment.source: You understand him fully. You can help him.<end>
segment.target: You understand him fully. You can help him.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Why would I want to help him?<end>
segment.target: Why would I want to help him?<end>

segment.target: What is the reason I am able to help him?<end>

segment.target: I want to help him.<end>

segment.target: I am not doing this.<end>

segment.source: Please listen, $(#sir/ma'am). <end>
segment.target: Please listen, $(#sir/ma'am). <end>

segment.source: I will lead you into his chamber. He will help you with the rest, $(#sir/ma'am). And when you leave that chamber, you will emerge different.<end>
segment.target: I will lead you into his chamber. He will help you with the rest, $(#sir/ma'am). And when you leave that chamber, you will emerge different.<end>

segment.source: Finally...<end>
segment.target: Finally...<end>

segment.source: ::Resolution.::<end>
segment.target: ::Resolution.::<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: What actually determines whether I can help him or not?<end>
segment.target: What actually determines whether I can help him or not?<end>

segment.source: Upon entering the chamber your mind will be exposed fully to him and to all that he is. And his presence is powerful. <end>
segment.target: Upon entering the chamber your mind will be exposed fully to him and to all that he is. And his presence is powerful. <end>

segment.source: You do not understand him sufficiently - you have not been conditioned. Whether you will endure or not... is something I cannot answer. And on that depends whether you will be able to help him or not.<end>
segment.target: You do not understand him sufficiently - you have not been conditioned. Whether you will endure or not... is something I cannot answer. And on that depends whether you will be able to help him or not.<end>

segment.source: You understand him already - you have been conditioned sufficiently. You will be able to endure it, $(#sir/ma'am). And you will be able to help him.<end>
segment.target: You understand him already - you have been conditioned sufficiently. You will be able to endure it, $(#sir/ma'am). And you will be able to help him.<end>

segment.source: What is going to happen to me in there?<end>
segment.target: What is going to happen to me in there?<end>

segment.source: Whatever must happen.<end>
segment.target: Whatever must happen.<end>

segment.source: Let's do this. I'm going in.<end>
segment.target: Let's do this. I'm going in.<end>

segment.source: Finally...<end>
segment.target: Finally...<end>

segment.source: ::[Will]:: No, you're playing with my mind. I don't want to go in there. I don't!<end>
segment.target: ::[Will]:: No, you're playing with my mind. I don't want to go in there. I don't!<end>

segment.source: You... will not go in there. <end>
segment.target: You... will not go in there. <end>

segment.source: I will enter his chamber. You will stay behind. The link will be severed, and after that you will be free to leave. Nothing else can be done, for your will was too strong. And after this... it will be even stronger, $(#sir/ma'am).<end>

segment.target: However, you don't understand him fully. Whether you are able to help him or not is not yet clear, $(#sir/ma'am). But he needs you to help him, and you will try to help him.<end>
